create_envlogger_with_riegeli_backend: create an EnvLogger wrapping a dm_env environment using the default Riegeli backend to log timesteps and actions
create_envlogger_with_in_memory_backend: create an EnvLogger wrapping a dm_env environment using the in-memory backend for transient logging
create_envlogger_with_custom_step_fn: create an EnvLogger with a custom step_fn callback to log extra data at every environment step
create_envlogger_with_custom_episode_fn: create an EnvLogger with a custom episode_fn callback to record metadata when each episode ends
create_envlogger_with_custom_backend_cal: create an EnvLogger passing a callable that returns a BackendWriter instance for custom logging behavior
